title: imap: LIST and STATUS command handlers
description: Add LIST/STATUS to crates/imap/src/commands/mailbox.rs. LIST: (1) reject if not Authenticated -> NO; (2) call ArticleNumberStore::list_groups() to get all (group_name, low, high); (3) filter by list reference and mailbox pattern (support * wildcard: anything, % wildcard: not crossing hierarchy separator '.'); (4) for each matching group, send * LIST (\HasNoChildren) '.' group_name; (5) send tagged OK. STATUS: (1) look up group; (2) compute requested items: MESSAGES=EXISTS count, RECENT=0, UNSEEN=count of articles without \Seen in imap_flags for this user, UIDVALIDITY from imap_uid_validity, UIDNEXT=next_uid; (3) send * STATUS mailbox (MESSAGES N UIDNEXT M UIDVALIDITY V); (4) tagged OK. Defensive: LIST with empty reference and '*' returns all; unknown mailbox in STATUS -> tagged NO [NONEXISTENT].
